verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-wide data export and no open-format export feature. It also shows no transfer-out or auth-code retrieval to support leaving; transfer evidence covers only transfers into name.com. The per-domain 'list DNS records' API endpoint is only a developer building block a user could script an export from, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Lists all DNS records for a specified domain.
